posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Have you Googled the stuff you're looking for?
RPG Maker MV comes with a slot machine plugin in the dlc folder.
@Mac15001900
wrote a blackjack minigame.
Blackjack minigame
Synopsis This plugin adds a Blackjack minigame. It will fit right in inside any casino in your game, but it's also customisable enough to not look out of place when played in a medieval tavern or on a futuristic spaceship.  Features  A fully functional Blackjack minigame: including animated...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
There are a bunch of threads about Rock, Paper, Scissors both with events and plugins.
I found plugins for both roulette and prize wheels.
There's a Triple Triad plugin, which may or may not be too derived for your project.

posts.author: JoeIXn
posts.body: I used common event calls and variables to make a simple slot machine, with pictures for reels and random number checks to decide wins. It worked well with a bit of tweaking.
